name: IconQA: A Benchmark for Abstract Diagram Understanding
description: IconQA is a visual question answering and abstract diagram reasoning benchmark comprising 107,439 questions across 33,408 icon and diagram images. Sourced from elementary school curricula, it features three core reasoning tasks: multi-image multi-choice QA, free-form image QA, and in-the-wild diagram completion.
